card.name: Small linking words before risk terms
card.fires_on: The comma after "bleeding" in the NSAID GI-risk warning, and short linking words ("of", "for") in section headings like "Development of Drug-Resistant Bacteria" or "Risk for Image Misinterpretation".

modes.label: Comma in bleeding list
modes.description: The comma after "bleeding" in the list "bleeding, ulceration, and perforation" in NSAID warnings.

modes.label: Heading link word
modes.description: "of" or "for" right after a numbered warning heading word such as Development or Risk.
modes.example: 5.1 Risk<< for>> Image Misinterpretation Image interpretation errors can

modes.label: Web text verb
modes.description: A verb like "avoid" in a general web tips list.
modes.example: Water grass at night or early morning to<< avoid>> evaporation
